_comment: Canned model script for the offline demo. These responses are AUTHORED, not recorded
from a live model: they exist so the pipeline can be exercised end to end with no API
key. Two of the five findings deliberately cite things the capture never produced —
#pricing-table is not in the geometry map and /checkout is not a captured route — so
the drop-and-count gate in packages/critique/src/hallucination-gate.ts deletes them and
reports the drops. Run with --model live to see what a real model says instead.

/.overall: The landing page reads clearly, but the announcement dismiss control is too small to hit and the hero headline competes with the primary action.

findings.title: Dismiss control is a 28x28 touch target
findings.description: The announcement dismiss button measures 28x28 CSS px in the captured mobile viewport, below the 44x44 minimum, and it sits immediately beside the primary call to action so a mis-tap starts a trial.
findings.suggestion: Pad the control to at least 44x44, keeping the 28px visual box if the smaller glyph is wanted.

findings.title: Headline and primary action carry similar weight
findings.description: At the desktop viewport the headline runs the full column width directly above the accent-filled call to action, so the eye lands on both at once instead of reading the headline first.
findings.suggestion: Shorten the headline measure or increase the gap above the call to action.

findings.title: Pricing table columns are unevenly spaced
findings.description: The three pricing columns do not share a common gutter, so the middle plan reads as narrower than the others.
findings.suggestion: Use the 24px spacing token between all three columns.

/pricing.overall: The pricing page is legible, but the Scale plan's action is an arrow glyph rather than a labelled control.

findings.title: Scale plan action is a 30x30 arrow glyph
findings.description: The Scale plan's call to action is a 30x30 CSS px arrow with no text label, while the Team plan's is a full-width labelled link, so the two plans do not offer the same affordance.
findings.suggestion: Give the Scale plan the same labelled control as Team.

findings.title: Checkout button uses a different radius
findings.description: The place-order button uses a 4px radius while every other action on the site uses the 10px radius token.
